abilities.name: infiltrator
abilities.effect: Bypasses light screen, reflect, and safeguard.

kanto.flavorText: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

original-johto.flavorText: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.

hoenn.flavorText: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and POKéMON. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.

updated-johto.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

original-unova.flavorText: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.

updated-unova.flavorText: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.

kalos.flavorText: Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Golbat bites down on prey with its four fangs and drinks the victim’s blood. It becomes active on inky dark moonless nights, flying around to attack people and Pokémon.

original-alola.flavorText: Sometimes they drink so much blood, they can’t fly anymore. Then they fall to the ground and become food for other Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and to suck blood.

swsh.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

pla.flavorText: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.
